title: Peracute
summary: PERACU'TE, adjective [Latin peracutus; per, through, and acutus, sharp.] Very sharp; very violent; as a peracute fever. [Little used.]

inlines.v: PERACU'TE, adjective [Latin peracutus; per, through, and acutus, sharp.] Very sharp; very violent; as a peracute fever. [Little used.]
